note: Authoritative inventory of every environment variable the code reads. Values live in Doppler (logloads project) and Vercel; never commit real values. `status` reflects repo truth and must be provider-verified before launch.

provider_verification.scope: Vercel Production variable names/targets, Supabase project and migration state, private media bucket, Anthropic credential-review readiness, Resend domain status, and code-derived activation gates
provider_verification.warning: Secret values remain intentionally unreadable. A variable listed as present is provider-verified by name and target, not copied into this document.

private_media_storage.rule: Supabase Storage is the only active private-media provider. The project reference must match the configured Supabase URL, the bucket must remain private with the exact media limits below, and any nonblank variable under a forbidden legacy prefix disables media.
private_media_storage.legacy_boundary: Historical cloudinary provider literals remain parseable as stored metadata only. No Cloudinary signing, upload, read-back, delivery, dependency, or environment activation path exists.

commercial_authority.terms: The host owes LogLoads 2% of host-stated driver pay, on top of that pay, for each load that physically completes once the host's confirmation settles it, whoever's trucks haul it. Fees are invoiced monthly in arrears and charged off-session to the host's card on file. Drivers and fleets pay nothing; there is no monthly fee, minimum, or posting fee, and LogLoads never holds transportation funds.
